decision_skill.name: verified_latent_override
decision_skill.description: Override a persistence forecast when verified future evidence explicitly describes a directional or multiplicative change in the underlying process, while separating real-world effects from reporting disruptions.
decision_skill.applicability: When the forecast window contains reliable evidence about a future latent-process change and the baseline assumes the cutoff level will persist.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the evidence-adjusted candidate over persistence only when the evidence directly applies to the forecast target and horizon, describes the underlying process rather than merely its observation, and unambiguously contradicts the baseline.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use the rule when evidence is outside the required temporal window, lacks provenance or exact-quote support, concerns only sensor or recording behavior, or is too ambiguous to determine the latent-process effect.
